findings.current: No matter how powerful a monster was, unless it possessed regenerative abilities greater than a Troll’s, it was bound to die if its neck or heart was pierced.
findings.defect: “Greater than” excludes regeneration equal to a Troll’s, whereas 트롤 이상 means equal to or greater than a Troll’s. This changes the stated survival threshold.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly sets Troll-level regeneration as the minimum exception to the otherwise fatal injury.
findings.replacement: No matter how powerful a monster was, unless it possessed regenerative abilities equal to or greater than a Troll’s, it was bound to die if its neck or heart was pierced.
findings.source: 아무리 강력한 몬스터라 하더라도, 트롤 이상의 재생력을 지니고 있지 않은 한 목이나 심장을 관통당하면 죽기 마련이다.

findings.current: Then, as if we had made an agreement, I kicked the Minotaur Lord’s head lying on the ground.
findings.defect: The draft incorrectly includes Jin in the implied agreement and omits that the humans and monsters had stopped and that he kicked the head toward them.
findings.rationale: 약속이라도 한 것처럼 modifies 그들, the halted onlookers, while 그들을 향해 supplies the direction of Jin’s kick.
findings.replacement: Then, toward those who had stopped as if by prior agreement, I kicked the Minotaur Lord’s severed head where it lay on the ground.
findings.source: 그리고 약속이라도 한 것처럼 멈춰선 그들을 향해, 나는 땅을 나뒹굴던 미노타우로스 로드의 대가리를 걷어찼다.

findings.defect: The draft changes the Skeleton King’s singular challenge into an invitation to attack the entire human side.
findings.rationale: 덤벼라 is directed at the monsters by the individual speaker; nothing in the Korean supports changing “me” to “us.”
findings.replacement: “All of you, come at me! You fucking monsters!”
findings.source: “다 덤벼라! 이 개 같은 몬스터 놈들아!”

findings.current: Of course, there was one major difference: they were hunting monsters, not human invaders.
findings.defect: The draft makes the contrasted humans into invaders. The source says the monsters are the invaders and contrasts hunting them with hunting humans.
findings.rationale: 침략자인 directly modifies 몬스터, while 인간이 아니라 establishes humans as what they are not hunting.
findings.replacement: Of course, there was one major difference: they were hunting invading monsters, not humans.
findings.source: 물론 인간이 아니라 침략자인 몬스터를 사냥한다는 점에서 아주 큰 차이점이 있긴 하지만.

findings.current: Even though we had arrived as quickly as possible, even though we had fought with everything we had, we still could not prevent their deaths.
findings.defect: The draft changes Jin’s personal actions and guilt from first-person singular to collective responsibility.
findings.rationale: The surrounding narration is Jin’s personal reckoning, and his later statement 나는 분명 최선을 다했다 confirms that the omitted subject here is Jin himself.
findings.replacement: Even though I had arrived as quickly as possible, even though I had fought with everything I had, I still could not prevent their deaths.
findings.source: 최대한 신속하게 도착했음에도, 최선을 다해 싸웠음에도 그들의 죽음까지 막을 수는 없었다.

findings.current: I silently repeated the title fixed in my mind.
findings.defect: The draft relocates the title from Jin’s visual field to his mind, flattening the source image of the characters reflected or lodged in his eyes.
findings.rationale: 두 눈동자에 틀어박힌 describes what his eyes are fixed upon; 마음속으로 applies to how he repeats the title, not where the title appears.
findings.replacement: I silently repeated the title reflected in my eyes.
findings.source: 나는 두 눈동자에 틀어박힌 그 두 글자를 마음속으로 뇌까렸다.

summary: The draft contains five substantive fidelity errors affecting a regeneration threshold, action subjects, the identity of the invaders, and Jin’s personal responsibility, plus one localized imagery shift.
